scope: Terrain/shader route captured before final world-ray-distance normalization; final pinned SDK separately passes desktop WebGL regression.
sampling: Latest at most 72000 frame intervals under 5000ms; elapsedSeconds is session wall time; modeFrames counts the whole session, not this rolling sample window. Long interruptions are excluded, so this is not uninterrupted endurance acceptance.
route: Alternates 3D heightfield / 2D tile map every 30 active seconds; animated dissolve shader and camera orbit / map scroll.
